title: Token Management System
seo_title: Token Management System | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Token Management System predicts and manages queues for hospital OPDs, banks and service centers — published client results report shorter, predictable waits.

blocks.x: Queues that behave. Token Management System issues tokens, predicts wait times and keeps service halls moving, in hospitals, banks and public service centers.

Token Management System is queue infrastructure for high-traffic service halls. It issues tokens across counters, predicts the wait for each queue, and balances load by steering arrivals and openings. A published hospital client described the result plainly: queues became visible, predictable and shorter.

items: Multi-counter tokens from kiosk, app or reception
Estimated waits shown to staff and visitors
Counters opened and arrivals steered before queues form
Wait and service times measured per counter, per hour

blocks.x: The platform runs on cloud or on-premise infrastructure and integrates with displays, kiosks and announcement systems. Queue data stays within the deployment; analytics dashboards serve operations managers with role-based access.

items: Displays, kiosks and audio announcements supported
Data stays on site where policy requires it
Managers see operations, staff see their counters

blocks.x: Hospital OPDs, bank branches, government service centers and telecom retail halls, anywhere footfall outruns counter capacity at predictable hours.
Book a briefing with the queue team. Bring your footfall pattern and we will show the wait-time curve it would produce.
